text.tspan: WS5 - PART 5 - Architecture Pattern Selector: Pool (A) vs. Hybrid (C) vs. Silo (B)
• Shared Cloud Run / WarmPool, Gateways & RLS
• 0ms atomic CAS promotion from Pattern A
• Dedicated GCP Project, VPC-SC & IAM PAB
• Outbound Agent-to-Target Gateway (2LO/3LO OBO + Output DLP)
• Non-spoofable KMS P-256 STS JWT (<0.15ms JWKS verify)
• Identical core-cymbal-agent/ Python code across Patterns A, B & C
• Only 20% Terraform perimeter variables change per tenant tier
• Eliminates multi-branch security, guardrail & prompt drift
• Zero-PII SHA-256 OpenTelemetry spans to BigQuery FinOps ledger
• ARD -94% schema pruning & Valkey 120/600 RPM fairness
shared in A & C; dedicated project, VPC-SC & PAB per tenant in B
shared Cloud Run/WarmPool in A; shared hub in C; Conf. GKE in B
shared RLS in A; isolated /28 PSC spoke in C; dedicated + HSM CMEK in B
